units.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons
units.text: 2. Collection or transfer (dissemination, provision or access) of personal data of judges, prosecution staff, investigators, persons conducting inquiries, internal affairs officers, military personnel, personnel of federal security service bodies, state protection bodies, foreign intelligence bodies of the Russian Federation, the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, bodies or institutions of the penal enforcement system, customs authorities or compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, in connection with their official activities or performance of public duty, or of personal data of persons close to them, in violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, except in the cases provided for by Part 1 of this Article, where those acts do not contain elements of a criminally punishable act, —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.13

units.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for individual entrepreneurs, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.13 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty…”

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: 1. A debtor’s violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings by failing to comply with an enforcement bailiff’s lawful demands, providing inaccurate information on the debtor’s rights to property, or failing to report termination of employment, a new place of work or study, the place of receipt of a pension or other income, or place of residence, except for the violation provided for by Article 17.17 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17.14

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17.14 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: 2. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to comply with a requirement contained in an enforcement document to recover money from a debtor —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.14

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for the bank or other credit institution of half the amount of money to be recovered from the debtor, but not more than one million roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.14 · “shall entail an administrative fine for the bank or other…”

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: 2.1. Failure by an issuer independently maintaining the register of holders of securities issued in series, or by a professional securities market participant recording rights to such securities belonging to a debtor, to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to debit those securities from the debtor’s securities register account or custody account and credit them to the enforcing creditor’s securities register account or custody account, where securities are present in the debtor’s corresponding account, —
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 17.14

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one third of the value of the securities issued in series that are subject to recovery, but not more than one half of the value of those securities.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 17.14 · “shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one…”

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: 3. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings by a person other than the debtor, by failing to comply with an enforcement bailiff’s lawful demands, refusing to accept confiscated property, providing inaccurate information on the debtor’s financial position, losing an enforcement document, failing to send an enforcement document in time, or failing to comply with the requirements of an enforcement document, including one received from the enforcing creditor, —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17.14

units.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17.14 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.text: 1. A debtor’s failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 1.1. Failure by a debtor that operates a search engine to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to stop displaying links providing access to information about a citizen on the Internet information and telecommunications network, within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 1.2. A debtor’s failure to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to cease disseminating information and/or retract previously disseminated information, within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 1.3. Failure by a debtor that is a state authority (state body), local self-government body or state (municipal) treasury-funded institution to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within the period established by legislation on enforcement proceedings —
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 2. A debtor’s failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 2.1. A debtor’s failure to comply with an enforcement document containing non-property requirements concerning fire safety, industrial safety or the safety of hydraulic structures, compliance with requirements in the field of construction and the use of construction materials (products), reconstruction, major repairs or commissioning of a capital construction facility, or ensuring the population’s sanitary and epidemiological well-being, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after a ruling imposing an administrative fine has been issued —
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; for legal entities, one million to three million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two hundred…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 3. Failure by a debtor that operates a search engine to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to stop displaying links providing access to information about a citizen on the Internet information and telecommunications network, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three…”

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: 4. A debtor’s failure to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to cease disseminating information and/or retract previously disseminated information, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 17.15

units.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, or administrative arrest for up to ten days, or compulsory work for up to one hundred and twenty hours; for officials, fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, or compulsory work for up to two hundred hours; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 17.15 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.text: 1. Violation of the rules for persons and/or vehicles crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation, or of the procedure for such persons and/or vehicles travelling from the State Border of the Russian Federation to crossing points through that border and in the opposite direction, as well as violation by such persons of the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation when undergoing border control, except in the cases provided for by Article 18.5 of this Code, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18.1

units.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to two million five hundred thousand roubles.

units.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The same acts committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18.1

units.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.

units.label: Part 3 Art. 18.1

units.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 18.1 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens…”

units.label: Art. 18.1 · “1. For administrative offences provided for by this Article and…”

A stateless person who has applied for a temporary identity document for a stateless person in the Russian Federation, has received that document, or has submitted an application for identity establishment provided for by Article 10.1 of Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-ФЗ ‘On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation’, shall not be subject to administrative liability for violating the rules for entering the Russian Federation or the rules governing stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, unlawfully engaging in employment in the Russian Federation, or violating immigration rules, where such violations were detected upon submission of the relevant application.
units.label: Art. 18.1 · “2. A stateless person who has applied for a temporary identity…”

units.text: 1. Violation of the rules for entry (passage) into the border zone, temporary stay, or movement of persons and/or vehicles within the border zone —

units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles.

units.text: 1.1. The same acts committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —

units.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 18.2 · “shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one…”

units.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone
units.text: 2. Conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities, or holding mass sociopolitical, cultural or other events in the border zone, as well as keeping or grazing livestock in the quarantine strip within the border zone, without permission from the border authorities, or with such permission but in breach of the established procedure for conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities; or violating the procedure for holding mass sociopolitical, cultural or other events in the border zone —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18.2

units.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

units.text: 1. Violation of the rules established in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation and in the Russian portions of border rivers, lakes and other water bodies for recording, storing, leaving and returning to bases, and presence on water bodies of Russian small self-propelled or non-self-propelled surface or underwater vessels (craft), or vehicles for travel on ice, —

units.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

units.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Conducting resource-harvesting, research, survey or other activities in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation, or in the Russian portions of border rivers, lakes and other water bodies, without permission from (notification of) the border authorities, or with such permission (notification) but in breach of its conditions —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18.3

units.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, twenty-five thousand to sixty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence.
